base_member_text: L55 indexes nfile(num) where num=nfile(i) (L52); since nfile=1:301 this equals nfile(i) here, but for any non-contiguous nfile this double-indexing would be a bug
audit_member_text: Double indexing/interface mismatch: num is already nfile(i) at L52, but L55 computes nfile(num). This happens to reproduce 1:301 for the default identity vector, while a non-identity subset can select the wrong frame or exceed nfile's range.

base_member_text: the loop bound is hard-coded 1:301 (L50) instead of 1:length(nfile), duplicating L15
audit_member_text: Use-before-range-validation across configuration lines: the loop is hard-coded as i=1:301 at L50 rather than length(nfile), then L52 indexes nfile(i). Any shorter user-selected nfile vector from L15 fails before loading.
